## Description

A side panel opened from the chart's Medicines card and the consultation plan: search the formulary (brand or generic), choose the strength, how often (1-0-0, 0-0-1, 1-0-1, 1-1-1, when needed, weekly), when (before food, after food, bedtime, any time), for how long (3 days, 5 days, 1 month, 3 months, ongoing) and the patient instructions. It shows the patient (name, age, the context that drives the checks) and the allergy chip, the safety checks for this line (MDV-P2-016, MDV-P2-040), the finished prescription line and the quantity. "Add to prescription" adds the line to the encounter's draft prescription; a severe finding blocks it until another medicine is chosen or an override reason is given.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The quantity is calculated from frequency and duration (when needed: one pack) and tested.
- [ ] **AC2.** The line uses the existing sig, so print and share are unchanged.
- [ ] **AC3.** From the chart without an open consultation, the panel says a consultation must be started; nothing is prescribed outside an encounter.
- [ ] **AC4.** Keyboard path, 44 px targets, English and Arabic right to left, axe clean.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
